- **The claim:** Viral online videos claimed thousands of brand new iPhones were floating in the Strait of Hormuz after a cargo ship sank.
- **Verdict:** ❌ False.
- **The evidence:** Fact-check investigations confirmed the video footage was generated using computer-generated imagery (CGI) following maritime shipping incidents [[Gulf News]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuAFBVV95cUxOeUxYWHlXeTRRNlZ4ZmdweG1WM3o0STcwUG1aczN3S3JKbEllZjZNVzdGaU9EYzJ0VV9wMUxrN3J1YWVEVm9pYXdMQ0YtZlA4cDN3R1hrQVRwVjROMHBiSVV5aGVuVzVLSnlXQnZkbW5rRWg4WmRSZW1JZ2NxZHJFN3JRNndyM2dMZzc2N2RmZnlfRlFQUndWQ2NMLXlpSmZ0Z0QtcGdxM1Y1N0Jna3FEUFNMdDlMdGdU?oc=5).

## 🛡️ Scams & safety alerts
- **The scam:** **Hyderabad digital arrest fraud**. Cybercriminals impersonating police or customs officers placed video calls to an elderly resident and his daughter, claiming their identity was used in money laundering, and cheated them of **₹29.17 lakh** [[Hyderabad Mail]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxQY3FJVk9BS3JadWVHLUtveWRaTFQxaUpSZ25GVzBpSnNNZVZHSGZITHVrNi14ZUk4ZnIzbGZwdHg5SlRzRTB5WkZzbm9jTmVtdVVVa2wxelppWlFYZU9MWHFsR1c4QkpWcW4tblJlaDNqVUVHTlVTclpKbUY3cFFvYUswRm95NmpBX1QzN2dPbVZqQQ?oc=5) [[Mid-Day]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
- **What to do:** Police, CBI, or customs agencies **never place video calls or demand money transfers to clear charges**. Disconnect immediately and call **1930** to report to the National Cyber Crime portal.
- **The scam:** **WhatsApp 'NO' reply phishing**. Fraudsters send messages asking recipients to reply 'NO' to cancel an unauthorized charge, which confirms an active phone line for secondary social engineering [[News18]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[Fortune India]](https://news.google.?oc=5).
- **What to do:** **Never reply to unsolicited automated messages**. Block and report the sender within WhatsApp.
- **Data breaches:** Claims surfaced regarding an **alleged leak of 3.75 lakh SBI user records** [[India Today]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5), while an **Oracle Health breach exposed records for nearly 20 million patients** in the US [[Fox News]](https://news.google.?oc=5).

## 🔮 Future signal
Google Quantum AI's **40-fold error rate suppression** in physical qubits represents the transition of quantum hardware from laboratory experiments to engineered systems [[Moomoo]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxObXpGVUpGNWw0YmQ0ZUV2NDlhS0hyVmlfYUhqR3Uydm90QV9rNEFoNUNETWhIbzFqTE9KWmM3MFdRc0RVdURSZzE5THJ1ZTYxWkJhSzdvaWxoejZ5Q2VXZk5UQU1JekVzNjJnNlZWY3BpbXRTRWxJb2xlUXVFMTNTRWQ3alFabDhBMXRMckdCQnlDMkJiMmpZVUFCRC1RTTE5TlZLenpfdldiTHM5eFY0OA?oc=5). While quantum advantage for general software remains years away, this reduction makes **fault-tolerant logical qubits viable before 2030**. In 5-10 years, this could break classical encryption models and revolutionize materials discovery. Watch for whether Google or IBM can link more than 1,000 error-corrected logical qubits over the next 24 months.

## 🎓 Today's lesson: Black Monday & Market Circuit Breakers
On this day in 1987, the Dow Jones Industrial Average plunged **22.6% in a single day**, an event remembered as **Black Monday**. The crash was accelerated by early automated computer trading programs selling stock index futures simultaneously. In response, global exchanges introduced **circuit breakers**: automatic trading halts that temporarily freeze the market when prices fall by 7%, 13%, or 20%. Think of a circuit breaker like an electrical fuse in your home: when a sudden power surge threatens to burn out the wiring, the fuse trips to cut the current and give everyone time to reset.
